thread:
nate: noticed a weird cluster of duplicate token charges in invoice-preview this morning, ~5 tenants, ~500 tokens each. spike aligns with a short outage in us-west and a bunch of client retries -> eu fallback around 12:02 UTC.
emma: do we have request ids for those events?
nate: grabbing a sample: tenant t-45f, two near-identical meter events 12:02:11 and 12:02:13, different req ids.
rachel: different req ids usually means dedupe won't catch it. why would req id change on retry? clientlib should reuse idempotency header.
kyle: edge logs show proxy doing a retry+route to eu and creating a new internal request id because `X-Req-Id` was being regenerated on reroute. we only dedupe on req_id + tenant.
emma: ah that explains dupes + invoice delta. aggregator relies on the incoming request UUID, not client-provided idempotency.
ops-bot: paste logs attached 
```
2024-06-02T12:02:10Z INFO proxy recv req client_id=t-45f x-idempotency=none x-req=R123
2024-06-02T12:02:10Z INFO proxy retry to eu-fallback new-req=R123-RT1 x-idempotency=none
2024-06-02T12:02:11Z INFO runtime meter emit tenant=t-45f req=R123 tokens=512 persisted=true
2024-06-02T12:02:13Z INFO runtime meter emit tenant=t-45f req=R123-RT1 tokens=512 persisted=true
```
nate: both persisted -> aggregator sees two positive events, invoice shows +1024.
rachel: we should have made the aggregator dedupe on an idempotency key if present, and fallback to req_id when missing. but clients sometimes don't send idempotency keys.
emma: short-term fix: do not regenerate X-Req-Id on proxy retry; preserve client-supplied Idempotency-Key or generate one before retry and copy it to both attempts. longer-term: aggregator change to use fingerprinting.
kyle: quick patch prepared to make proxy preserve `Idempotency-Key` header across route hops and to stop mutating `X-Req-Id` on internal retries. simple config change in proxy filter.
rachel: can we also add a micro dedupe: aggregator to coalesce events within 5s for same tenant+fingerprint if tokens match exactly. that would help other edge races.
emma: tradeoffs: time-window dedupe could hide real separate requests if clients legitimately fire two similar requests quickly. but 5s seems safe for retries. we need telemetry to avoid false negatives.
ops-bot: rollout plan: patch proxy to preserve header -> canary 5% -> observe invoice-preview and metering. patch aggregator small change optional in next sprint.
billing-bot: ALERT invoice-preview shows duplicate spikes for tenants t-45f,t-91b,t-c3d resolved in canary after proxy change.
nate: deployed proxy patch to canary at 12:30, can confirm preview deltas returned to baseline.
rachel: follow-up: create a console doc for "Idempotency & Metering" that says aggregator prefers Idempotency-Key, then request-id, then fingerprint. also add metric `metering.duplicate_retry_count` and an alert if > 10/min for any tenant.
emma: created PR #8502 for docs + telemetry. also opened a backlog ticket to implement aggregator fingerprint dedupe (AGG-112).
kyle: thanks all. ops: schedule a cleanup reconciliation job to reconcile the 3 affected invoices (remove duplicate token artifacts).
ops-bot: scheduled one-off reconcile job for 2024-06-03 01:00 UTC. will post results.
billing-bot: RECON RESULT: 3 tenants adjusted (-1536 tokens aggregated).
nate: excellent. closing thread. :party_popper:
